Meta is working on a project started by the iMasons
Climate Accord (iCA)↗ and OCP to address the impact
of embodied carbon on data center sustainability. The
project’s primary objective is to develop a standardized
framework for disclosing and managing embodied
carbon in data center construction and operation.
